name: features-section-demo-1
title: Feature Grid Section
blurb: Responsive 4-column grid of feature cards with decorative grid background.
description: Eight feature cards with gradient backgrounds and decorative SVG grid patterns. Responsive layout adapts from 1-column mobile to 4-column desktop.
use_when: Feature lists or capability showcases where card-based layouts with consistent styling scale to many items.
avoid_when: Content-light layouts where 8+ cards may overwhelm or create layout imbalance.
a11y: Cards are semantic containers; titles and descriptions are readable. Grid SVG patterns are decorative and not announcedt.
